name: arc-cloud
description: ARC Cloud — multi-tenant IoT platform (MVP: identity, device registry, MQTT ingestion, telemetry)

scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @arc/shared && npm run build -w @arc/api -w @arc/ingestion-worker
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: npm run build && rm -rf coverage/e2e-raw && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=coverage/e2e-raw tsx tests/e2e/run.ts && npm run coverage:e2e
scripts.coverage:e2e: c8 report --temp-directory coverage/e2e-raw --reports-dir coverage/e2e --reporter text-summary --reporter json-summary --reporter html --all --src apps/api/src --src apps/ingestion-worker/src --src packages/shared/src --include 'apps/api/**' --include 'apps/ingestion-worker/**' --include 'packages/shared/**' --exclude '**/test/**' --exclude '**/*.d.ts' --exclude-after-remap --check-coverage --lines 90 --branches 75 --functions 88
scripts.openapi: npm run build -w @arc/api && node apps/api/dist/openapi.js docs/api/openapi.json
